notes: Every choice in the layout maker now draws itself. Each rune, each arrangement and each hero shows a real live preview of what that card would actually look like, built by the same code that draws it on the desktop.

The layout maker looks like the rest of the Control Panel. It had its own colors and its own typeface written into it by hand; it now uses the same design system as every other window, so it follows your theme.
The arrangement and hero choices are now announced as two separate questions under the rune you picked, instead of running together in one unlabelled list.
Fixed: the layout maker preview painted a white sheet over the desktop wallpaper behind the strip.
Fixed: a preview could be drawn slightly too large for its box and clip the last letter of a word when the picker list started to scroll.
